mechanism_narrative: MET (RTK) and IL6ST/gp130 (cytokine receptor) are both expressed in aged MuSC and myofibers. Under forced proximity via flexible_GS4 linker (~20 Å), MET's kinase domain transphosphorylates IL6ST's intracellular tyrosines, creating docking sites for GRB2-SHC1-GAB1-PIK3R1-PTPN11 adaptors. This biases signaling toward MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT pathways while sterically excluding PLCγ (cannot bridge the asymmetric MET-IL6ST geometry). JAK1/2 remain cis-associated with IL6ST and provide STAT3 activation. The net output upregulates muscle structural/contractile genes (ACTA2, MYL9, MYH11) characteristic of young muscle and downregulates aged IEGs (EGR1, FOS, JUN, IL32) and aged markers (MYF5, MYH9, ASB5).
